import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlBu_r', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_sleep.index))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width, occupation_sleep['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 1].bar(x, occupation_sleep['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width, occupation_sleep['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='salmon')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Top 10 Occupations: Sleep & Stress Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset, alpha=0.5, label=bmi, bins=15)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender
colors = {'Male': 'steelblue', 'Female': 'lightcoral'}
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 0].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'], 
                       alpha=0.6, label=gender, color=colors[gender], s=50)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# 5. Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    bp = axes[1, 1].boxplot([sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]['Heart Rate'] 
                            for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique()],
                           labels=sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique(),
                           patch_artist=True)
    colors_box = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
    for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors_box):
        patch.set_facecolor(color)
    axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
else:
    axes[1, 1].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data Available', 
                   ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 1].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 2].imshow(correlation_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 2].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols, fontsize=10)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 2], fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add values to heatmap
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 2].text(j, i, f'{correlation_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                              ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
